None of the candidates provide this capability:

- The agents (Engineering Change, Production Change, Asset Lifecycle orchestrators) handle operational workflows for engineering changes and material provisioning, not financial analysis
- The data products assess workforce readiness and production capability for transitions, not supplier financial health

The candidates are topically related to procurement/supply chain but lack the financial monitoring, credit rating analysis, or supplier health metrics capabilities needed for this activity.
